text: I. Program mission: To grasp foundational knowledge and systematic professional knowledge in Geological Engineering; to develop scientific research capabilities and technical expertise in practical work; to demonstrate an international perspective and the potential for collaboration and innovation; to become high-level professionals with professional technological and managerial skills in the global petroleum industry. II. Program orientation: 1. Petroleum geology and exploration 2. Geophysical exploration III. Training methods and program duration: Training methods: Three stages for training engineering master's students, namely course study + professional practice + academic dissertation. The professional practice stage shall last no less than half a year. Students shall independently find an enterprise or company to complete this stage and provide materials for their academic dissertation. Program duration: 3 years IV. Credit requirements: Minimum 30 credits in total and minimum 15 credits for compulsory courses. V.
